description: AMD EPYC 7742 hardware observations of the extended native bundle (ia32-epyc-ext, campaigns 000-211, microcode 0x830107c) of cases the IA-32 model got wrong before the fixes of the extended run (strict mismatches by root cause, documented-undefined flags by instruction, RCP/RSQRT lanes); expected states are the hardware rows. Records are the inputs as the oracle really ran them (EFLAGS.ID/NT inherited from the previous case: native_fp.oracle_start_flags). test/epyc_regression.py replays them.
